community_pool.precedent: 28,066,894 SWTH has historically been paid out via passed proposals

distribution_pool.spendable_via: not a spendable pot: this is the fee-pool accounting backing delegator/validator claims; MsgCommunityPoolSpend cannot take it (feePool CommunityPool accounting excludes outstanding rewards)

module_and_user_value_tvl.why_not: No Carbon module exposes a governance message that transfers module balances. Checked carbon-js-sdk v0.11.75 tx protos for all 30 modules: only MsgUpdateParams / relayer / controller / blacklist style ops carry an authority (gov) field; fund-moving messages (bridge MsgWithdrawToken, coin MsgAdminIbcWithdraw, insurance MsgTopUpInsurance, perpspool MsgWithdrawFromPool, liquiditypool MsgRemoveLiquidity, adl MsgPayBadDebt) are creator/controller/relayer/user-gated, not authority-gated. Reaching this TVL requires a malicious software upgrade (validators must run modified binaries) or a bridge-controller compromise.

bridges.escrowed_value: not separately measurable post-halt; bridged denom supplies on the assets page are small (e.g. usdc.1.2.343151 supply 292,932,560 raw, eth.1.2.942d87 0.069 ETH at 18dp) and many rows are 2^63 placeholders
bridges.note: A governance capture could add itself as relayer (authority MsgAddRelayer) and potentially confirm forged pending actions, but that requires the chain to run and the capture to succeed first.

liquidity_pools.module: x/liquiditypool (native AMM) — counted inside Demex/Nitron TVL
liquidity_pools.spendable_via: LP shares are user-owned; gov cannot spend them directly

insurance_fund.withdraw_message: none in the SDK — the fund is consumed by bad-debt/adl logic per params ('percentage of the total insurance fund that can be used per interval')

conclusion: The only directly gov-movable asset is the community pool: 55,321,211 SWTH unspent (~$8.9k nominal). Its realizable value is bounded by the single Osmosis exit pool (~$606 of OSMO). The $250,097 chain TVL is P-class (software upgrade / privileged) and S-class (frozen by the halt), not capture-proceeds.
